their_evidence: Making Friends and Influencing People (S2E3): Hunter lines up a shot on someone he doesn't know is Simmons; May wounds Hunter to stop him; May, who knows of Simmons' mission, allows her and Gill to escape to maintain her cover.

stages.title: The Avengers

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#20
stages.text: After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Hill leads the Air Force to Coulson's hideout at Providence, hoping a deal will keep his team out of prison. When the soldiers take the team captive, she fights them off and helps Coulson's people escape.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An old colleague. Hill seeks a deal for his team, then frees them.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An old colleague who brings the Air Force, then helps Coulson's team escape.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#19

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An old colleague Coulson sends the intel on Strucker's base.

their_evidence: The Dirty Half Dozen (S2E19): Coulson is called by Maria Hill and gives her the intel from the Hydra base, telling her to assemble the Avengers; Wikipedia: he gives the location to Hill so the Avengers can defeat Hydra.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#15
stages.text: Sif teams up with May to recapture the escaped sorceress Lorelei, and the two warriors bond over Sif's sword. Sif warns May that Lorelei once enchanted a man she cared for and urges her to be ready to do what is needed about Grant Ward.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An Asgardian warrior who helps May recapture Lorelei and warns her about Ward.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow warrior who helps Sif recapture Lorelei, bonding over Sif's sword.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#12
proposed.text: When Sif comes after Skye, May takes Skye to Vault D and tries to calm her. Skye knocks herself out with May's I.C.E.R., which convinces Sif to leave her to May's team.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An Asgardian warrior who comes after Skye while May shields her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow warrior who shields Skye from Sif in Vault D.

their_evidence: Who You Really Are (S2E12): Sif and Vin-Tak go after Skye; May takes Skye to Vault D; Sif's arrival agitates Skye, who shoots herself with May's I.C.E.R., convincing Sif Skye can be handled by her team. May and Coulson then escort Sif away.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#15
stages.text: Sif comes to Earth hunting the escaped Asgardian Lorelei, and Coulson's team helps her track Lorelei down and capture her. Sif is shocked to find Coulson alive and agrees to keep it from Thor.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An Asgardian warrior Coulson helps capture Lorelei.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The agent Thor believes is dead. Helps Sif capture Lorelei.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#12
proposed.text: Coulson's team helps an amnesiac Sif catch the Kree Vin-Tak, and Coulson talks her out of taking Skye. Sif warns him that Skye may be more dangerous than he knows.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An Asgardian warrior Coulson talks out of taking Skye.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The agent who helps Sif catch Vin-Tak and keeps Skye from her.

their_evidence: Who You Really Are (S2E12): S.H.I.E.L.D. helps amnesiac Sif, captures Vin-Tak; Coulson convinces Sif to leave Skye be; Sif warns Coulson Skye may be a greater danger than he realizes.
